description: The Supabase fork's data layer: a user-scoped server client that is subject to RLS like any other caller, a browser client, and a service-role client walled off under $lib/server/admin/. Ships the RLS lint that fails a migration creating a table without enabling row level security in the same file.

scripts.types:gen: supabase gen types typescript --local > src/lib/database.types.ts && prettier --write src/lib/database.types.ts
scripts.types:gen:linked: supabase gen types typescript --linked > src/lib/database.types.ts && prettier --write src/lib/database.types.ts

env.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
env.note: Project URL. Public by design — it ships in the browser bundle.

env.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.note: The sb_publishable_... key, which replaces the legacy anon key. Public by design: every query it makes is subject to row level security. If your project predates the new keys, the anon key still works here.

env.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
env.note: The sb_secret_... key, which replaces the legacy service_role key. BYPASSES row level security — server only, never in a PUBLIC_ variable, and only importable from $lib/server/admin/. Required for the admin screens and for seeding the storage bucket.
